help.answer: Point to the lower stone pan, then the higher leaf pan. Stone heavier, leaf lighter in this model. Adult reteaches one object on each pan and waiting.

recheck.answer: Use the actual observation, not object names. Accept heavier/lighter/equal with correct pan explanation; no functioning balance means practical comparison not assessed.

fresh.answer: C is heavier than D because C pan is lower. Actual new-pair result is conditional: accept accurate heavier/lighter/equal observation even after a mistaken prediction.

delayed.answer: Accept actual settled result and pan explanation; predict before testing. Bigger does not always mean heavier; explain using a tested counterexample or the explicitly observed story example. Record support; no balance means practical comparison not assessed.
